newsitem.title: USA: Western Pacific Air completes placement.
newsitem.headline: Western Pacific Air completes placement.

text.p: Western Pacific Airlines Inc said Tuesday it completed a private financing with three institutional investors for $10 million through the purchase of a three-year convertible preferred equity security.

In return for this investment, Western Pacific said it issued 10,000 shares of its Series C preferred stock which will be subject to voluntary conversion into common stock during its three-year term and will automatically convert into company common stock on the third anniversary of its issue.
The number of shares issuable upon conversion is variable and will depend upon the dates of conversion and changes in the market price of Western Pacific common stock, the company said.
Western Pacific said two series of warrants have also been provided to these investors.

The company said 213,333 warrants are exercisable over a five-year period at an exercise price of $11.25, and 367,308 warrants are exercisable over a three-year period at an exercise price initially set at $6.80625 but subject to possible upward price adjustment based upon changes in the market price of Western Pacific common stock.
The company said it will use the money for general working capital purposes and to support the company's recently announced plans to enter the Denver market on June 29.
